sample_unit: GPT-4 responses (15 medication regimens x 2 prompts)

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of GPT-4 clinical recommendations for drug-drug interaction regimens
links.effect: Inappropriate recommendations potentially causing harm in 14% of responses (2/14); 63% (19/30) accurate but incomplete; intended DDI identified in 90% (27/30).
links.quote: Inappropriate clinical recommendations potentially causing patient harm were provided in 14% of responses provided by GPT-4 (2/14), and 63% of responses contained accurate information but incomplete recommendations (19/30).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the baseline accuracy and clinical safety of GPT-4 on simulated medication regimens for drug-drug interactions, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
